test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the word from the options which is exactly opposite in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.**

She relished our **(arguments)**, most of which she won.
solution: The correct answer is **"agreements."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Arguments"** means angry discussions between two or more people who disagree with each other. (विवाद, झगड़ा, बहस) • **Example**: *Leela had **arguments**__ with her father about politics.* • ***​*"Agreements" **means harmony or accordance in opinion or feeling. (राय या भावना में सामंजस्य या अनुरूपता) __ • **Example**: *The dispute was settled by **agreements**__ that satisfied both sides.* • So, the word which is exactly opposite in meaning to the bracketed word is** "agreements."** • Therefore, Option 4 is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: Altercation** means a noisy argument or disagreement. (विवाद, झगड़ा, कहा-सुनी, अनबन) • **Option 2: Negotiations** involve discussion and compromise to reach an agreement, but they still involve some level of disagreement. (वार्ता (किसी निर्णय या समझौते पर पहुँचने के लिए लोगों में बातचीत) • **Option 3: Feud** means a prolonged and bitter quarrel between two parties. (दो व्‍यक्तियों या व्‍यक्ति-समूहों के बीच लंबे समय तक चलने वाला झगड़ा; पुश्‍तैनी रंजिश) 1a8:Tdff, The correct answer is **"have a headache."**
